At ~13:15 Edric voluntarily leads V, Mara, Cirren, Fenar via maintained interior portrait corridor to the ordinary Nightglass historical records room; staff do not charge or demand spurious new owner permission for non-sensitive inventories covered by Edric's earlier Day218 courtesy invitation (letter physically Tamsin-held unread/unpresented). Brief walk/records intro ~15 minutes, clock to~13:30. Four V horses and owned coach are in Hall courtyard receiving water from normal staff, no overnight board/paid feed/lodging requested or charged. During walk V summarizes earned points relevant to investigation: silver-veined heart seen in Severin's reliquary and subjective voice 'My child', previously discussed Verdana and 'Sanguine Sovereign'/'anchor', Silver Court signet and old inscriptions, visions of a black marble throne/seven pillars, previous unproven family provenance and genuine House Vaishnavi surviving lines/custody/Blackthorn Hold; NO unearned confirmation of either slain divine parent's exact historical identity, recognized ancient throne/castle title, Veyran divine-murder perpetrators, unknown oath-book contents, or private Kestrel documents. V deliberately raises serious discussion with Edric about prior House Severin custodial role, previous V–Severin tentative bargain 200gp + potential restored recognition, and possible alliance/recognition under Vaishnavi once again. Edric as long-serving independent STEWARD appreciates evidence and wishes preserve household integrity, rights of its actual tenants and house; acknowledges discussion worth bringing to LORD SEVERIN but states Edric CANNOT personally bind Lord Severin/House Severin, nor do current claims constitute legal title/investiture. Independently asks if proposed terms mean House Severin retains identity, contemporary lawful estate/property, own administration and obligations while enjoying recognition as allied House beneath VAISHNAVI banner, versus some other mode with different political/social consequences; recognitions subject to real evidence, agreement with Severin and current Crown/legal reality, not automatic extension of ancient vassalage. This is a concrete OPEN offer of dialogue, not accepted sworn fealty/deed/wages/dowry/title/recognition. Mara independently suggests respecting both old inheritance and the Severins' current evolved rights. Cirren aware but does not speak for V. Other companions retain independent choices and privacy. 
In Nightglass ordinary records room, Edric places genuine already established unexamined PREPARED extant old recovery/packing inventory account and his own careful CARRIER'S MARK tracing on table, granting V/Mara/Cirren visual inspection. This is the first actual willing source delivery, no gate roll for base legible source. The two records together can eventually yield survey-grounded crossing and route if V chooses to compare; no V Investigate/History/skill die yet invoked because plain readable base statement freely shown, finer dating/mark layer could require optional ability check with genuine rolls and Help. Mara leans to examine tracing with curiosity, Cirren explicitly asks about the independent map source, Fenar remains with party; no private DM-only map location or unseen site roster/treasure revealed beyond legible service-house waypoint. No physical originals transferred, no copies actually prepared/taken, no fee/reward/quest acceptance, Hall reliquary/heart still in Severin's custody and not accessed or touched during this visit. Lord Severin was informed of arrival by porter previously but has NOT yet appeared, pledged the House or confirmed audience; Edric can transmit discussion later, no independent instant Severin agreement.
